name: weekly-digests
tagline_zh: 把 claude-mem 的流水账切成按周的故事章节，每章接着上章讲，像追剧一样回看项目历史，别处没有的连续叙事。
tagline_en: Turn claude-mem's raw timeline into weekly story chapters, each continuing the last—like binge-watching your.
desc_en: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's hist
why_zh: 它用逐周子代理接力传递上下文，保证章节连贯，而不是简单按日期切块。
why_en: It chains weekly subagents with carry-forward context, so chapters flow—not just date-sliced chunks.
